note: The private half of tests/data/mapmaker_focus_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the typing in the map maker's boxes for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): a box that a re-render takes out of the page (moved, which a browser counts as taken out) loses the focus, the caret that is not put back, the focus that goes to another control, one script at a time against the check of its dialog (tests/scripts/web_mapmaker_*_check.js, which type through the fake DOM of web_mapmaker_fake_dom.js). Run from the checkout: tools/mutate.py tests/data/mapmaker_focus_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1; every mutant must be caught. tests/scripts/test_web_mapmaker.py runs the same list on a copy of the files.
